mapper.select: SELECT CAST(im_phrase_group_id AS CHAR) AS imWordsGroupId, group_name AS name, CAST(parent_group_id AS CHAR) AS parentGroupId, sort_no AS sortNo FROM im_phrase_group WHERE camp_id = #{campId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY COALESCE(parent_group_id, 0) ASC, sort_no ASC, im_phrase_group_id ASC

SELECT CAST(p.im_phrase_id AS CHAR) AS imWordsId, p.title AS title, p.content AS content, g.group_name AS groupName, CAST(p.im_phrase_group_id AS CHAR) AS imWordsGroupId, DATE_FORMAT(p.updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updatedAt FROM im_phrase p JOIN im_phrase_group g ON g.im_phrase_group_id = p.im_phrase_group_id AND g.camp_id = p.camp_id AND g.status = 1 WHERE p.camp_id = #{campId} AND p.status = 1
AND p.im_phrase_group_id = #{groupId}
AND ( p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR g.group_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY p.sort_no ASC, p.im_phrase_id DESC
SELECT CAST(config_value AS CHAR) FROM system_config WHERE camp_id = #{campId} AND config_scope = 'camp' AND config_key = #{configKey} ORDER BY system_config_id DESC LIMIT 1
